deadline.value: Applications are reviewed for admission and assistantships after the February 1 deadline for international and domestic applicants.
deadline.quote: February 1 for International and domestic applicants

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: Admission and assistantship funding are decided together by the faculty committee after review; no guaranteed funding is stated.
funding.quote: This application packet is reviewed for admission and funding for Teaching Assistantships by the Data Science PhD Program's faculty committee

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree or equivalent from a regionally accredited university is considered for admission.
entry_route.quote: Applicants who hold a Bachelor of Science degree or equivalent from any regionally accredited university

gre_general.value: The department requires GRE scores with no exemptions, but sets no minimum score.

also.quote: While there is no minimum GRE score requirement, the overall score may be taken into consideration

toefl_min.value: The department states only the old 550 paper-based and 79 internet-based scores, which are not recorded; the Graduate School's 4.5 (new scale) applies.
toefl_min.quote: minimum score of 79 on the IBT

ielts_min.value: The department states an IELTS minimum of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: minimum score of 6.5 on the IELTS

fee_waiver.value: The department says the application fee has no waivers.

notes: The department says there is no Spring admission.
